summary: Updated Reference 7 to an HTTPS archive capture of Jerome’s part IV with a direct link to p. 149. The regenerated reader opens the registered PDF in Chromium, exposes both Advent common psalms under their parent heading, and identifies Jerome’s first-person invitation on p. 158.
